CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_factory_owner.manual_authoring_assert_v1(p_operation text, p_source uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE a mission_factory_owner.manual_authoring_admissions_v1; ready mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness;
 u uuid:=auth.uid();
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO ready FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton FOR SHARE;
 IF u IS NULL OR ready.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'enabled' OR ready.scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff'
 OR ready.observed_revision_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM ready.revision_sha256
 OR NOT ready.staff_guards_verified OR NOT ready.published_assets_verified
 OR nullif(btrim(ready.independent_review_ref),'') IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MF_MANUAL_AUTHORING_RELEASE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF mission_public_owner.public_authoring_allowed_v1(false) THEN
  PERFORM mission_public_owner.public_authoring_assert_v1(p_operation,p_source,u); RETURN;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO a FROM mission_factory_owner.manual_authoring_admissions_v1
 WHERE actor_user=u AND release_sha256=ready.revision_sha256 AND enabled FOR SHARE;
 IF a.actor_user IS NULL OR a.expires_at<=statement_timestamp()
 OR p_operation IS NULL OR NOT(p_operation=ANY(a.operations))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.characters c JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=c.user_id
 WHERE c.id=a.actor_character AND c.user_id=u AND pr.role IN('admin','master'))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l WHERE l.id=a.location_id AND l.is_active AND l.is_test)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MF_MANUAL_AUTHORING_STAFF_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_source IS NOT NULL AND (
 p_source='db1588ae-50f2-4c0e-9028-0b94155d94b1'::uuid
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.missions ms WHERE ms.id=p_source AND ms.created_by=u
 AND ms.status='annullata')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions ms WHERE ms.mission_id=p_source AND ms.closed_at IS NULL)
 OR NOT (
  (p_source=ANY(a.source_ids) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources line
    WHERE line.carrier_mission_id=p_source))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.publications pub
    WHERE pub.mission_id=p_source AND pub.actor_user=u AND pub.target='staff'
    AND pub.release_revision_sha256=a.release_sha256
    AND pub.state='preparing' AND pub.transaction_id=txid_current() AND pub.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid())
 )) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MF_MANUAL_AUTHORING_SOURCE_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
END $function$
